headline: Catawba top the table and outscore the conference
dek: Catawba won 13 times and conceded 23 goals across all their matches. Their season still ended in a home defeat, to Lenoir-Rhyne, the side second behind them in the table.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Catawba's 50 goals in all their matches are more than Anderson, Tusculum and Emory & Henry scored together, and the attack that leads the chart belongs to the side that leads the table.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Fourteen matches are past their date with no result; the latest is Emory & Henry's home match with Regent.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Carson-Newman drew seven of their matches, more than any other programme.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Tusculum lost 12 of their matches, conceding 45 goals and scoring 12.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lauren Zitt has seven shutouts in goal for Catawba.

last_match.line: Carson-Newman are the only other conference side to have won at Catawba.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
